title: Every public entry point reports the same plan and rejects a changed scene during differentiation

fixture.scene: tests/test_plan.py::scene: 2D region 1.6 x 1.5 x 1.4 um, uniform mesh 0.1 um (16 x 15 cells), Yee material sampling, 3 PML cells (x_min: 4 layers, kappa 2, alpha 0.03, alpha_polynomial 1), courant_factor 0.99, 24 steps, one SiN (n = 2) rectangle 0.3 x 0.4 um at (-0.3, 0.1), one continuous Ez point source at (-0.2, 0) with wavelength 1.1 um, either two point monitors (Ez at (0.1, 0), Hy at (0, 0.1)) or one x-normal field monitor 0.65 x 0.55 um at x = 0.12 um with downsample 2
entry_points: run_tensor_batch (CUDA, two copies of each variant, cuda_graph False)
fixture.mutation_scene: the same scene on a 4.8 x 4.8 um graded mesh (mesh_max 0.3, mesh_ppw 6, wavelength 3 um, 10 steps) whose automatic refinement boxes follow the structure
fixture.runtime_checks: YeeGrid and differentiable _System prepared from the same project compared to the plan: CPML b, c, 1/kappa, time step, wrap phases, source locations and waveform samples

reference_method: exact comparison of the plans (hash and every array) across entry points; the runtime grid coefficients and source tensors are compared to the plan cast to the runtime dtype; the differentiable signals of the plan material equal the native traces within fp32 tolerance

observables.name: shared_plan_hash
observables.definition: one hash across all entry points for each monitor variant

observables.name: shared_arrays
observables.definition: nodes, Yee axes, dt, CPML profiles and coefficients, source locations/samples/profiles, ADE coefficients, monitor points/weights/frequencies equal across entry points

observables.name: runtime_agreement
observables.definition: prepared grid coefficients and source tensors equal the plan; a grid of another scene raises PlanInvalidated

observables.name: mutation_rejection
observables.definition: moving the refined structure after construction raises PlanInvalidated on the next forward of the resident, streamed and plane wrappers

observables.name: native_vs_differentiable_signals
observables.definition: DifferentiableSimulation on the plan material versus Simulation traces

acceptance.source_of_limits: exact identities; the native-versus-differentiable signal tolerance is tighter than completion_gates.json discrete_dimensionless_fp32 (rtol 1e-4, atol 1e-6)

not_yet_covered: the browser streamed and tiled jobs (execution_modes.run_streamed_job, run_tiled_job) do not report plan_hash yet
EndpointSimulation, TensorDielectricSimulation and the reversible wrappers do not expose plan_hash yet

notes: Simulation and run_tensor_batch run from plan.material and plan.source_terms and verify the prepared YeeGrid and FrequencyPlanes against the plan; the differentiable wrappers keep their own _System preparation and enforce the plan by a construction-time snapshot of the scene and its realized nodes.
